social_circle.name: Donna Gangaram

demographics.occupation: Office administrator and dispatch coordinator for an agricultural supply company
demographics.education: High school diploma with some community-college office and bookkeeping classes; no degree

background.how_they_met: Donna is Bernadette's mother and raised her in the Denver metro area.
background.why_close: Bernadette relies on Donna for stress, budgeting decisions, practical advice, and family support. Donna taught her record-keeping, bill discipline, and staying calm under stress.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear full sentences, asks follow-up questions, sends reminders, and checks in without being dramatic. Uses occasional exclamation points but little slang.

shared_activities: Sunday dinners at Bernadette's parents' home
help with medication reminders and appointments
recent_text_topics: Bernadette's dental bill and how to budget around the crown payment.
Donna checking whether Bernadette is sleeping enough during early shifts and training responsibilities.
Plans for the next Sunday dinner, usually simple food like grilled chicken or chili.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Bernadette texts her mom several times a week and calls maybe once, and that her mother is the person she calls when stressed or making a budget decision. Q103 says her mother worked in office administration and dispatch for an agricultural supply company.

social_circle.name: Marisol Reyes

background.how_they_met: They met through a board-game night several years ago.
background.why_close: They share art, cooking, museum visits, thoughtful political conversations, and a steady low-drama friendship. Bernadette texts Marisol when she is having a hard time.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts conversationally and often, with links, exhibit screenshots, recipe ideas, and occasional emojis. More expressive and politically outspoken than Bernadette.

shared_activities: talking openly about race, politics, and stress
recent_text_topics: Coordinating a Denver Art Museum exhibit visit and whether to get dinner afterward.
Checking in after Bernadette's work stress from training newer operators.
Sharing recipes for low-cost weeknight meals and jokes about not buying overpriced workday burritos.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Bernadette's closest friend is Marisol, whom she met through board-game night, and that they cook together and go to the Denver Art Museum. Q44 says Bernadette talked to Marisol after a work near-miss. Q49 says she texts Marisol instead of posting publicly when she is having a hard time.

social_circle.name: Lena Whitaker

demographics.education: Associate degree in health care administration

background.how_they_met: They became roommates through a mutual friend when both needed an affordable place on Denver's east side.
background.why_close: They share a lease, split household bills, respect each other's quiet routines, and coordinate daily apartment logistics.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short, practical messages about groceries, bills, chores, and timing. Usually friendly but not overly emotional; prefers direct coordination.

shared_activities: maintaining a chore list on the fridge
recent_text_topics: Utility bill timing and confirming each person's share.
Chore list swaps when Bernadette has overtime or Lena has a long health care admin day.
Whether to share dinner or watch an episode together after work.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q11 says Bernadette lives with one roommate, Lena, who is in her late twenties and works in health care administration; they split rent and utilities, keep separate groceries, share chores, and sometimes watch a show or share dinner. Q55 confirms Lena and Bernadette split rent and utilities.

social_circle.name: Marcus Gangaram

demographics.education: High school diploma with some automotive technical coursework

background.how_they_met: Marcus is Bernadette's younger brother; they grew up together in the Denver suburbs with both parents.
background.why_close: They are close but not constantly in contact. Their bond is practical, family-centered, and built around shared Denver roots, work stress, and low-key family gatherings.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually with jokes, short updates, and sports reactions. More likely than Bernadette to use memes, slang, and quick one-line replies.

recent_text_topics: Scheduling coffee before or after a family Sunday dinner.
Broncos or Avalanche reactions after games.
Car maintenance questions and joking about family members quietly stressing instead of saying so.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Bernadette has one younger brother, that they are close but not constantly talking, and that they usually catch up over coffee or when the family gets together. Q46 says her brother has normal work and money stress and jokes more when stressed.

social_circle.name: Richard Gangaram

demographics.education: High school diploma plus trade training and equipment certifications

background.how_they_met: Richard is Bernadette's father and raised her around tools, construction work, machines, and practical repair habits.
background.why_close: Their relationship is quiet and practical. He shaped Bernadette's comfort with equipment, maintenance, skilled trades, and self-reliance.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts less often than Donna, usually about something specific: a repair question, weather, tools, or logistics. Uses brief sentences and rarely adds emotional language.

shared_activities: talking in the garage during visits
discussing trucks, repairs, weather, and work
recent_text_topics: Checking on his knee after a flare-up and whether he needs a ride to an appointment.
Tool or car maintenance questions, including small repair advice.
Weather and job-site conditions during smoke, heat, or cold mornings.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Bernadette's relationship with her dad is practical and quiet, that they talk about work, trucks, repairs, and weather, and that he texts less but about specific things. Q35 says he has knee problems and Bernadette has driven him to an appointment. Q106 says he worked construction and equipment operation.
